title: Bungiveagh and Bungardilaun
html_source:
A mocking reference to the Guinness brothers (not twins), owners of the brewery, using their aristocratic titles:
Edward Guinness, 1st Earl of Iveagh (1847–1927)
Arthur Guinness, 1st Baron Ardilaun (1840–1915)

A bung is a stopper used in a beer barrel.
